readings.commitment: The Republic's constitution is its magistracies: annual, collegial, and vetoable offices that parceled the king's power into pieces no one could reassemble
readings.delta: Suppression of monarchical reassembly (colleague's veto, annual term); beneficiary is the office-holding class in rotation; victim set is would-be permanent holders; extractiveness of office time-boxed

readings.commitment: The Republic's constitution is the Senate's authority: a permanent council whose auctoritas, not legal command, steered finance, war, and religion for centuries
readings.delta: Suppression by prestige rather than command; beneficiary is the senatorial order; victim set is magistrates and assemblies acting against its weight; extractiveness of policy concentrated in an unelected permanence

readings.commitment: The Republic's constitution is popular: assemblies elected every magistrate and passed every law, and the tribunes' sacrosanct veto shielded the plebs from the rest
readings.delta: Suppression of magisterial overreach by intercession; beneficiary is the plebs and its tribunes; victim set is patrician unilateralism; extractiveness checked by bodies the elite had to persuade

readings.commitment: The Republic's constitution began with the Twelve Tables: law wrested from priestly memory and posted in the Forum where any citizen could read his rights
readings.delta: Suppression of secret patrician law; beneficiary is plebeians subject to known rules; victim set is pontifical legal monopoly; extractiveness of arbitrary adjudication reduced by publication

readings.commitment: The Republic's constitution included its own suspension: the term-limited dictatorship and the final decree, emergency forms that saved the state until they ended it
readings.delta: Suppression of ordinary checks during declared crisis; beneficiary is the state's survival, then the strongman; victim set is vetoes and appeals while the emergency runs; extractiveness unbounded inside the window

readings.commitment: The magistracies' core is collegiality: every power held jointly, every colleague a veto, so that command itself carried its own brake
readings.delta: Suppression of unilateral imperium; beneficiary is whoever the veto rescues; victim set is decisive single command; extractiveness of office checked by its own duplicate

readings.commitment: The magistracies' core is the calendar: one year and out, iteration restricted, so that power expired before it could consolidate
readings.delta: Suppression of incumbency accumulation; beneficiary is the rotation-awaiting elite; victim set is continuity of policy; extractiveness of office bounded by the consular year

readings.commitment: The magistracies form a ladder: quaestor to consul in prescribed order and age, a career structure that socialized ambition into sequence
readings.delta: Suppression of meteoric ascent (Scipio and Pompey as scandals); beneficiary is the orderly senatorial career; victim set is extraordinary talent and extraordinary danger alike; extractiveness of office rationed by stage

readings.commitment: The Senate was the Republic's mind: the one continuous deliberative body, holding finance and foreign policy because someone had to hold them between elections
readings.delta: Suppression of discontinuity; beneficiary is policy coherence across annual offices; victim set is assembly impulsiveness; extractiveness of decision lodged with the experienced

readings.commitment: The Senate was capture institutionalized: a self-perpetuating nobility of ex-magistrates whose 'advice' was command and whose interest wore the Republic's name
readings.delta: Suppression of popular initiative by procedural weight; beneficiary is the nobiles and their estates; victim set is the land-hungry plebs and the provinces; extractiveness of empire channeled to one order

readings.commitment: The Senate legally only advised: its decrees bound no one without magisterial action or assembly vote, and its power evaporated whenever someone called the bluff
readings.delta: Suppression dependent on deference, not law (Tiberius Gracchus called it); beneficiary is whoever tests the convention; victim set is auctoritas itself once tested; extractiveness of senatorial control contingent on belief

readings.commitment: The tribunate rests on sacrosanctity: the tribune's person inviolable by collective plebeian oath, his veto a body placed between citizen and magistrate
readings.delta: Suppression of magisterial coercion against the protected person; beneficiary is the pleb seized by a consul; victim set is unobstructed imperium; extractiveness of arbitrary enforcement blocked by a human shield

readings.commitment: The centuriate assembly voted by wealth class: the people's sovereignty organized so the propertied centuries voted first and usually decided everything
readings.delta: Suppression of one-man-one-vote inside popular form; beneficiary is the propertied classes; victim set is the proletarii voting last if at all; extractiveness of electoral weight indexed to the census

readings.commitment: The Hortensian law made plebiscites bind everyone: the plebs' own resolutions became Roman law without senatorial confirmation, ending the orders' long war
readings.delta: Suppression of patrician legislative veto; beneficiary is plebeian institutions as lawmakers; victim set is patrician confirmation rights; extractiveness of class-exclusive lawmaking ended in form

readings.commitment: Before any vote came the contio: the persuasion assembly where magistrates faced the crowd, the Republic's actual public sphere
readings.delta: Suppression of voting without hearing; beneficiary is orators and the audible crowd; victim set is decisions that cannot survive a hearing; extractiveness of consent manufactured or denied in the open

readings.commitment: Sacrosanctity is the plebs' shield: the inviolable tribune exists to stand between the powerless citizen and the magistrate's rods
readings.delta: Suppression of coercion at the point of contact; beneficiary is the individual pleb; victim set is summary magisterial force; extractiveness of enforcement interrupted body by body

readings.commitment: Sacrosanctity became the demagogue's lever: an untouchable office with veto over everything is the perfect instrument for ambition wearing the people's clothes
readings.delta: Suppression of governance by single protected actors (Clodius); beneficiary is the tribune's own faction; victim set is public business held hostage; extractiveness of the shield repurposed as a weapon

readings.commitment: Sacrosanctity ended as the emperor's costume: Augustus took tribunician power perpetual and entire, the plebs' shield refitted as the throne's foundation
readings.delta: Suppression of the office by absorption of its aura; beneficiary is the princeps inviolable forever; victim set is the tribunate as counter-power; extractiveness of popular protection converted to monarchic title

readings.commitment: The classical dictatorship was the emergency done right: total command, six months maximum, named for a single task, and laid down early by the likes of Cincinnatus
readings.delta: Suppression of checks bounded by clock and task; beneficiary is unified command in crisis; victim set is appeal and veto inside the window; extractiveness of emergency power capped by design

readings.commitment: The final decree replaced the dictatorship with a blank check: 'let the consuls see the state takes no harm,' authority without office, term, or defined limit
readings.delta: Suppression of legality by exhortation (citizens killed without trial under it); beneficiary is the consuls and the order behind them; victim set is Gracchans and Catilinarians dead without appeal; extractiveness of emergency unbounded and deniable

readings.commitment: Sulla's dictatorship inverted the form: indefinite tenure 'to write the constitution,' proscription as method — the emergency office used to rebuild the state that it was breaking
readings.delta: Suppression of opponents by published death list; beneficiary is the Sullan settlement and its profiteers; victim set is the proscribed and their heirs; extractiveness of reform financed by confiscation

readings.commitment: The dictatorship proves emergencies can be constitutionalized: name the danger, bound the time, and absolute power returns its commission
readings.delta: Suppression of crisis improvisation; beneficiary is the legal order that survives its own suspension; victim set is open-ended emergency claims; extractiveness of the exception domesticated

readings.commitment: The dictatorship is the paradox of legal suspension: an office inside the law whose content is the law's absence, teaching that the constitution contains its own negation
readings.delta: Suppression of the law by the law's own instrument; beneficiary is sovereignty theory; victim set is the rule-of-law self-image; extractiveness of the exception revealed as constitutive

readings.commitment: The dictatorship was rehearsal: every well-behaved Cincinnatus normalized the form that Sulla extended and Caesar made perpetual
readings.delta: Suppression deferred, not avoided (each good use stockpiled legitimacy for the bad); beneficiary is the eventual perpetual dictator; victim set is the Republic across a longer clock; extractiveness compounding through precedent

readings.commitment: Athens' constitution is the lottery: offices filled by lot and rotated yearly, on the theory that election is aristocratic and chance alone is democratic
readings.delta: Suppression of professional office-holding; beneficiary is the ordinary citizen's equal chance; victim set is expertise claims and electoral magnates; extractiveness of office defeated by randomization

readings.commitment: Athens' constitution is the ekklesia: the assembled citizens deciding war, finance, and law directly, forty times a year, with no government above them to appeal to
readings.delta: Suppression of delegation itself; beneficiary is the present and voting demos; victim set is representative mediation; extractiveness of policy belonging to whoever attends

readings.commitment: Athens' constitution is its audits: every office-holder examined on exit, every proposer liable for his decree, ostracism waiting for whoever grew too large
readings.delta: Suppression of unaccountable service (euthynai for all); beneficiary is the demos as principal; victim set is officials and orators bearing personal liability; extractiveness of office priced in personal risk

readings.commitment: Athens' constitution stands on exclusion: the citizen equality of perhaps one resident in five, financed by slaves, metics, and an empire's tribute
readings.delta: Suppression of the majority from the demos itself; beneficiary is the adult male citizen body; victim set is women, slaves, metics, and tributary allies; extractiveness of participatory leisure borne by the excluded

readings.commitment: Sortition's point is anti-professionalism: no political class can form where office is chance, brief, and audited
readings.delta: Suppression of incumbency and careerism; beneficiary is amateur government's equality; victim set is accumulated political skill; extractiveness of office capture made structurally impossible

readings.commitment: Sortition operationalizes equality: where votes measure persuasion and wealth, the lot alone gives every citizen literally identical access to rule
readings.delta: Suppression of all selection gradients; beneficiary is the statistically ordinary; victim set is every basis of distinction; extractiveness of office distributed flat

readings.commitment: Sortition knew its limit: generals and treasurers were elected — where incompetence kills, Athens quietly preferred aristocratic selection
readings.delta: Suppression of the lot where stakes were lethal; beneficiary is military competence (and Pericles' career); victim set is pure-sortition theory; extractiveness of the exception: power flowed to the elected posts

readings.commitment: Ostracism is accountability's bluntest tool: a yearly vote to exile any citizen for ten years, no charge, no defense — prominence itself the offense
readings.delta: Suppression of over-mighty individuals pre-emptively; beneficiary is the democracy's fear of tyranny; victim set is the exiled-without-wrongdoing; extractiveness of standing taxed at its peak

readings.commitment: The graphe paranomon made proposers liable: persuade the assembly of something later judged unlawful and you, not the assembly, pay — the democracy's self-binding through its orators
readings.delta: Suppression of demagogic proposal at the proposer's risk; beneficiary is decisional stability; victim set is bold initiators; extractiveness of bad persuasion charged to the persuader

readings.commitment: The euthynai audited everyone: no official left office without accounts examined and conduct open to any citizen's accusation
readings.delta: Suppression of exit-without-reckoning; beneficiary is the principal demos; victim set is peculating or abusive officials; extractiveness in office clawed back at the door

readings.commitment: Ostracism was the safety valve: ten years' exile without disgrace or confiscation, a way to break elite deadlock before it broke the city
readings.delta: Suppression of factional escalation; beneficiary is civic peace; victim set is one principal per crisis, gently; extractiveness minimal by design (property kept, return scheduled)

readings.commitment: Ostracism regulated the elite tournament: aristocrats mobilized it against each other, the demos serving as referee of rivalries not of its own choosing
readings.delta: Suppression of whichever rival lost the mobilization contest; beneficiary is the winning faction; victim set is the loser and referee-theory of the demos; extractiveness of the tool captured by its targets

readings.commitment: Ostracism was arbitrary power undressed: exile by popularity contest, no charge to answer, the institution that banished Aristides for being called 'the Just' once too often
readings.delta: Suppression without process at all; beneficiary is collective whim; victim set is the un-accused exiled; extractiveness of citizenship revocable by mood

readings.commitment: Athenian citizenship was a guarded estate: Pericles' own law restricted it to double descent, the democracy tightening its border as its value rose
readings.delta: Suppression of citizenship diffusion; beneficiary is the existing citizen body's shares; victim set is mixed-descent residents stripped prospectively; extractiveness of belonging rationed by blood

readings.commitment: The democracy ran on slave labor: mines, households, and crafts worked by the unfree bought the citizen his assembly pay and jury leisure
readings.delta: Suppression total for the enslaved majority's claims; beneficiary is the participating citizen; victim set is the enslaved, in the silver mines above all; extractiveness maximal and constitutive, not incidental

readings.commitment: The democracy ran on empire: allied tribute financed the fleet, the festivals, and the pay that made participation possible — democracy at home, hegemony abroad, one budget
readings.delta: Suppression of allied autonomy (revolts besieged); beneficiary is the Athenian demos as collective rentier; victim set is the tributary cities; extractiveness exported to the league
